status: Three minimal native opt-ins proposed for root final integrated validation; not a claim of reaching House30x

incremental.implemented: Fuse output structural-depth metadata construction into the mandatory splice loop
incremental.not_implemented: No subtree incremental bytecode cache, branch/constant relocation cache, or dirty propagation framework
incremental.prior_rejection: Prior selected-parent slot provenance reuse already avoided hashes and brought <1% full-search gain; not replayed

sharing.implemented: Defer parent phase copying until crossover publication; skip copy-before-overwrite of successfully replaced phase and copies restoring rejected attempts
sharing.lifetime: Immutable parent borrowed only during one crossover kernel; every published output remains independently materialized
sharing.not_implemented: No cross-generation DAG, no physical site aliasing, no changed logical genotype
sharing.copy_traffic: Each avoided selected-parent phase copy saves reads and writes of44bytes per node plus16bytes per constant; actual selected-phase aggregate bytes were not instrumented

lowering_workspace.implemented: Borrow immutable source nodes by index and use12-byte lowering frames, with ordinary-width fallback beyond signed16-bit code-capacity proof
lowering_workspace.not_incremental: Every source node is still lowered and checked
lowering_workspace.source_change_attribution: Node access changes from stored reference to a local value even in the copied-node reference specialization. Standalone index-flag deltas do not measure the whole source change.

validation.root_first_stage: Root reports original depth/copy affected3tests passed
validation.index_stage: 2focused CUDA compiler/owner tests passed;32-generation exact AST/fitness/operator replay
validation.compact_stage: 2focused CUDA compiler/owner tests passed including32768codecapacity fallback and all3compiler variants
validation.final_assertions: Independent bytecode-verifier max_stack_depth and result-type certificate assertions added after those runs; root final rebuild/test required
validation.all_case_contract: All measured search generations contain1024programs x1024cases with no unscored cases; exact per-generation semantic/operator/error traces and final/history ASTs compared
validation.history_comparison: elapsed_search_ms excluded; all other history fields and final AST JSON exact
